description: Term-centric sweep for Task 737, third pass, from the 2026-11-01 audit: Scenario vs Status (am, my), Link vs Pipe (24 languages), Pattern vs Graph/Mode (bg, ru, uk, zh), Source, Label, Depth, Curve, HGL and Demand consistency. Junction vs Node left for Tom.

entries.complaint: English 'Source' in the branched-network calculator is the supply (a reservoir or pump station), and cs Reservoir is Zdroj too, so the same Czech word names both; the water-quality Source is Dávkování, which is distinct.
readings: Source here means the supply, so Zdroj equal to Reservoir is correct and nothing changes
Source here should get a word apart from Reservoir (for example Zásobní zdroj)
entries.resolution: bpn_ Source is the branched network's supply point, a reservoir in effect; Zdroj names it correctly in cs and the bpn_ calculator has no Reservoir to confuse it with.

entries.complaint: The glossary term 'demand' records လိုအပ်ချက် (from the bpn_ sprint), but လိုအင် is the majority word in lpn_ keys. လိုအပ်ချက် also means 'requirement', which collides with 'required' in ip_no_solution.
readings: Use လိုအင် everywhere (applied)
Use လိုအပ်ချက် everywhere, per the glossary
entries.resolution: Demand is the majority လိုအင်; လိုအပ်ချက် also means requirement. Glossary my Demand updated to လိုအင်.

entries.complaint: Node has four renderings (နေရာ 93 keys, Latin node 51, အမှတ် 44, and the Junction word). Only the Junction-word leak was changed (to အမှတ်, the word in lpn_ts_group_nodes); the rest awaits Tom's Junction/Node call.
readings: နေရာ as the one Node word
အမှတ် as the one Node word
entries.resolution: Outside sprint 737c's scope: Junction and Node words wait on Tom's call (Task 737). Only the Junction-word leak into Node keys was fixed.

entries.complaint: Chinese EPANET itself renders Pattern as 时间模式, which contains the Mode word 模式. A Pattern word that differs from Mode had to be a new term.
readings: Pattern = 时变系数 (chosen, distinct from Mode 模式)
Pattern = 时间模式 (EPANET's own), with Mode renamed instead
entries.resolution: Pattern is EPANET's 时间模式, a compound distinct from bare 模式 (Mode); the invented 时变系数 was replaced. Written back to the glossary.
